image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a silver alloy rim with five thick, split spokes and a central hubcap with a red emblem. A black rubber tire with visible tread patterns and sidewall lettering surrounds the rim. The wheel is situated within a rusty brown wheel well, resting on a light-colored concrete or paved surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The rust texture on the fender arch appears slightly smudged and painterly, lacking the fine granular detail of real corrosion, though it fits the overall aesthetic.
The white text on the tire sidewall is illegible and slightly melted into the rubber texture, a common AI artifact when rendering small text.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To check for bleeding or fusion artifacts where the metal rim meets the rubber tire, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the wheel sits correctly on the ground plane and that the depth relationship between the tire, rim, and fender is physically valid.
To assess the realism of the lighting reflections on the metal and the texture consistency of the rust and concrete.

focus_areas: Integrity of the rim-spoke connections (no floating or melting parts)
Sharpness and physical plausibility of the tire tread pattern
Boundary clarity between the tire sidewall and the wheel well
Legibility and structure of any text/logos on the hubcap or tire
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the alloy spokes; AI often generates asymmetrical or unevenly spaced spokes. Verify if the shadow cast by the tire onto the ground matches the lighting direction implied by the highlights on the rim. Check if the 'rust' on the fender looks like natural oxidation or just noise overlay.
